conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.empty_body: When someone starts a chat, it appears here with the full transcript.

detail.whisper_note: Operator instructions. The visitor never saw these.
detail.empty_body: Nothing was recorded for this conversation.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Accounts live on this server only. There is no cloud login, and a reset never leaves your own mail server.
auth.wrong_password: That password does not match this username.
auth.server_error: The server could not answer that, so the password was not checked. Nothing is locked and nothing is wrong with the account — try again in a moment.
auth.key_prompt: Signing in with a key instead?
auth.blocked_title: Too many failed attempts on this account
auth.blocked_body: Five wrong passwords in a row, so this account is locked. If that was not you, someone is guessing — an administrator can unlock it and force a password change from the users tab.
auth.empty_title: No accounts exist on this installation
auth.empty_body: This is a fresh install and nobody has signed up yet. The first account you create becomes the administrator — it can add everyone else afterwards.
auth.offline_title: This browser cannot reach your Tel-Agent server
auth.offline_body: No response from {host}. Your calls are unaffected if the machine is still running — this is a network problem between you and it. Check that you are on the business network or connected to the VPN.
